description: This file contains functions and data for handling MAF (Mass Air Flow) sensor readings, including sensor voltage retrieval, decoding lookup, and specific sensor calibration data for various MAF sensor types.

methods.name: getMaf
methods.description: Returns the MAF sensor voltage using engine parameters.

methods.name: hasMafSensor
methods.description: Checks if the engine configuration has a MAF sensor.

methods.name: getRealMaf
methods.description: Calculates the kg/hour MAF value from ADC reading.

methods.name: fillTheRest
methods.description: Fills remaining decoding entries with placeholder values for binary search.

methods.name: addMafPoint
methods.description: Adds a MAF point with kg/hr value and voltage to the decoding array.

methods.name: setBosch0280218037
methods.description: Sets calibration data for Bosch 0280218037 MAF sensor.

methods.name: setBosch0280218004
methods.description: Sets default calibration data for Bosch 0280218004 MAF sensor.

methods.name: setDensoTODO
methods.description: Sets calibration data for Denso MAF sensor.

methods.name: setMazdaMiataNAMaf
methods.description: Sets calibration data for Mazda Miata N/A MAF sensor.
